title: Synthetic population of households in Amsterdam
descriptions: This synthetic dataset is created based on the Dutch housing survey 2021 using spatial microsimulation (Iterative Proportional Fitting technique). The aim was to represent the entire population of households in Amsterdam by expanding a limited sample size, in order to construct a comprehensive agent-based model.
